youtube_title: Cracking Knuckles = Arthritis? The Answer Surprises | Body Fix #20 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #20. Crack crack crack... and Mom says you'll get ARTHRITIS!
B is right. Studies found NO link to arthritis.
The crack = a gas bubble in joint fluid. One doctor cracked one hand for 60 YEARS: no arthritis.
Fix: Occasional cracking is fine. Don't force joints; stretch if stiff.
Red flags: Pain, swelling, or a joint that locks? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: Harvard Health - knuckle cracking
